name: Neferiti
source:
Ruthless captain of the Federation. She commands the most offensive ship in the galaxy, the Firebolt. Neferiti demands efficiency in all her dealings, and will not stop until she has achieved her goal. How she successfully downed so many Pirate Lords remains a mystery.

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
